node.statement: Joint infeasibility of the z-row constraints. The transverse-moment demand 1.4 requires sum_j P_{zj}·x_j = 1, while the transverse-moment budget 1.5 (applied to the admissible row i = z) requires sum_j P_{zj}·x_j ≤ C·tau. Combined with the numerical gap C·tau < 1, these give 1 = sum_j P_{zj}·x_j ≤ C·tau < 1, i.e. 1 < 1, an impossibility; so no coefficient vector (P_{zj}) can simultaneously satisfy the demand, the mass-one/negative-mass constraints, and the confinement.
node.inference: contradiction (equality of 1.4 dominated by strict bound of 1.5)
